evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Ensure MCP-enabled work has usable raw telemetry for debugging.
intent.acceptance: Independently inspect recursively discovered gateway.jsonl or rpc-messages.jsonl bytes, not report assertions.

profile.scope: Only evidence explicitly bound to the reviewed current profile; historical source compatibility is not established.
profile.baselineReconstruction: Open: phenomenon pre-exists adoption; no comparable baseline established or exhaustion claimed.
profile.nativeSchema: Workflow Phase 3; gateway_logs_types.go EffectiveType uses nonempty legacy type before event.

evidence.opportunity: MCP-configured runs in an independently preserved source-capped seven-day cohort, not the repository fleet.
filters: At most 20 selected runs; normally at most two per workflow, third requires preserved repeated-critical-gap reason.
Preserve candidate inventory and selection rationale: failed/cancelled, firewall-enabled, MCP-configured, then recent successes.
Require immutable run configuration and exact source-profile binding; no eligibility from report text or successful status.
Seven-day disjoint interval windows; shorter leading period remains interim, not a complete weekly comparison.
evidence.collection: Read retained, digest-checked cohort/configuration projections and raw artifact bytes once for all windows; no network. Missing producer inputs are null, not absent logging.

model.architecture: Native capped-cohort telemetry prerequisite, separate from full debugging acceptance and contribution.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no source-defined keep bar or measured matching costs.
